ssh_host_trust.scope: SSH host key first seen by the operator at first contact, then read inside the guest and carried in the attested manifest (Intel TDX report_data = SHA-512 of that manifest). Proves the key is held by a genuine Intel TDX guest on the provider image that answered this attestation. NOT_PROVEN: a workload-unique VM identity (provider image measurements are shared across VMs; RTMR3, MRCONFIGID and MROWNER are zero) and exclusion of an active on-path attacker that rewrites guest commands. Provider stated on 2026-10-02 that no authenticated host-key source exists.
